exposure: knowledge of pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT)
outcome: participation in pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT)
cohort: 1982 postpartum women who gave birth at the Women's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine from August to November 2017 and had weak PFM
finding: Younger maternal age, cesarean section, and no delivery injury were associated with weak PFM strength, while higher educational level was also associated with better type II muscle fiber strength.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be a prognostic factor for weak PFM strength (both type I and type II muscle fibers).
